text.p: Carver Corp said Wedensday its inability to ship two key products -- a tuner-preamplifier and a five-disk compact disk changer -- will result in much lower revenues than expected and a loss for the fourth quarter.
Carver said it had expected to report a profit for the period.
The company said revenues were hurt by the continued delay of one of its new vendors in shipping the two key audio products.
Carver will be unable to ship sufficient units to fill the backlog for these two products until the first quarter of 1997, it said.
It said the problems associated with the late delivery of these products were caused primarily by the vendor's lack of familiarity with the company's product design specifications.
